description: This Python source file implements a JSON Schema URI resolver, including classes and functions for resolving references, handling remote schemas, and managing resolution scope.

classes.name: RefResolver
classes.description: A class to resolve JSON references, handle scope, cache schemas, and dereference $ref and id fields within JSON schemas.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Retrieve the schema's identifier, supporting both '$id' and 'id'.

methods.name: resolve_path
methods.description: Resolve a JSON Pointer fragment within a schema.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalize a URI to its canonical form.

methods.name: resolve_remote
methods.description: Fetch and decode a remote schema from a URI, using custom handlers if provided.
